name: 19830-decode1k-8bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=10, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% by completion. Moderate load for this card and shape, not saturation.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 100 (min = max on both), greedy, and ignore_eos is forced by the fixed max_tokens, so every request has the same shape. The chat template plus add_special_tokens put ~1011 tokens on the wire rather than 1000.
purpose: An eight-billion Llama-class chat assistant writing short replies to page-length prompts for ten concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Not redundant defaults: this is the scheduler budget a `vllm serve` of this checkpoint resolves
# on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card. Pinned rather than left to fall through, which gives 2048 / 128.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
